roles.label: Roles
roles.tagline: Which roles count as owner, moderators, VIPs and subscribers.

ownerRoleId.label: Owner role
ownerRoleId.help: Full control. Bagel treats this role as staff everywhere.

leadModRoleId.label: Lead Mod role
leadModRoleId.help: Senior moderators. Counted as staff on tickets.

modsRoleId.label: Mods role
modsRoleId.help: Your moderators. Counted as staff on tickets.

vipRoleId.label: VIP role
vipRoleId.help: Bagel creates this role and its private channels. You hand it out yourself.

subscriberRoleId.label: Subscriber role
subscriberRoleId.help: Bagel creates this role and its private channels. You hand it out yourself.

regularsRoleId.label: Regulars role
regularsRoleId.help: Bagel creates this role. You hand it out yourself.

pinnedRoles.label: Pinned
pinnedRoles.help: A pinned slot keeps the role you chose: the next setup adopts it instead of creating or renaming one by name.

live.label: Live alerts
live.tagline: Announce when the stream goes live.

liveChannelId.label: Go-live channel
liveChannelId.help: One post when you go live, edited when you go offline.

categoryAllow.label: Announce only these categories
categoryAllow.help: Empty means every category is announced.

categoryDeny.label: Never announce these categories
categoryDeny.help: A denied category wins over the allow list.

twitchLogin.label: Twitch channel
twitchLogin.help: The Twitch channel named in the live post.

clipsChannelId.label: Clips channel
clipsChannelId.help: Every clip from !clip and from Twitch itself.

welcomeChannelId.label: Welcome channel
welcomeChannelId.help: One embed per new member. Bagel never DMs joiners.

goodbye.label: Goodbye
goodbye.tagline: Say goodbye in the welcome channel when someone leaves.

autorole.label: Auto role
autorole.tagline: Give every new member a role.

memberRoleId.label: Member autorole
memberRoleId.help: Given to everyone who joins while automatic roles are on.

subscribers.label: Subscriber rooms
subscribers.tagline: Private rooms for subscribers and VIPs.

subsChannelId.label: Subscriber channel
subsChannelId.help: The private text channel for your subscriber tier.

subsCategoryId.label: Subscriber category
subsCategoryId.help: The category the subscriber channels live under.

vipChannelId.label: VIP channel
vipChannelId.help: The private text channel for your VIPs.

vipCategoryId.label: VIP category
vipCategoryId.help: The category the VIP channels live under.

voice.label: Voice rooms
voice.tagline: Join a hub to get your own voice room.

voiceHubId.label: Join-to-create voice hub
voiceHubId.help: Joining this voice channel clones a personal room.

voiceCategoryId.label: Voice room category
voiceCategoryId.help: Rooms are created only in this category. Required once a hub is set.

voiceNameTemplate.label: Room name
voiceNameTemplate.help: Use {owner} for the member name. Empty uses the member name alone.

voicePrivacy.label: Room privacy
voicePrivacy.help: Open, locked to new joiners, or hidden from the channel list.

tickets.label: Tickets
tickets.tagline: A private help desk with staff and transcripts.

ticketChannelId.label: Ticket panel channel
ticketChannelId.help: Where the Open a ticket panel is posted.

ticketCategoryId.label: Tickets category
ticketCategoryId.help: New ticket channels are created under this category.

ticketArchiveCategoryId.label: Archive category
ticketArchiveCategoryId.help: Closed tickets move here instead of being deleted. Leave unset to delete them.

ticketStaffRoleIds.label: Who handles tickets
ticketStaffRoleIds.help: These roles see and can claim every ticket. Leave all unticked to use your staff roles.

ticketOpenLimit.label: Open tickets per member
ticketOpenLimit.help: How many tickets one member may have open at once.

ticketTranscriptEnabled.label: Save transcripts
ticketTranscriptEnabled.help: On close, the whole conversation is saved and posted to the ticket log as a text file.

ticketLogChannelId.label: Ticket log channel
ticketLogChannelId.help: Close summaries and transcripts land here. Falls back to your staff log channel.

ticketPanelColor.label: Colour
ticketPanelColor.help: The bar down the left of the embed.

logs.label: Server logs
logs.tagline: Record what happens in the server.

logChannelId.label: Staff logs channel
logChannelId.help: Joins, leaves, edits, deletes and moderation.

logVoiceEnabled.label: Voice logs
logVoiceEnabled.help: Joins, leaves and moves in voice channels.

logIgnoreBots.label: Ignore bots
logIgnoreBots.help: Skip messages and joins from bots.

logMessagesChannelId.label: Message logs channel
logMessagesChannelId.help: Empty uses the staff logs channel.

logMembersChannelId.label: Member logs channel
logMembersChannelId.help: Empty uses the staff logs channel.

logVoiceChannelId.label: Voice logs channel
logVoiceChannelId.help: Empty uses the staff logs channel.

logModerationChannelId.label: Moderation logs channel
logModerationChannelId.help: Empty uses the staff logs channel.

logIgnoredChannelIds.label: Ignored channels
logIgnoredChannelIds.help: Nothing from these channels is logged.

levels.label: Levels
levels.tagline: Members earn XP and levels by chatting.

linkguard.label: Link guard
linkguard.tagline: Remove links from members unless allowed.

linkAllowList.label: Allowed links
linkAllowList.help: Parts of a link to allow, separated by commas. Example: youtube.com, twitch.tv
